Ad Blocker for Firefox on iOS
Built-in · Optional · Reduces clutter
>];problem[label=<
Problem
Pop-ups, overlays and ads
can take over your screen and
get between you and your content.
>];solution[label=<
Solution
Built into Firefox for iOS: it blocks
many third-party ads and ad-related
trackers before they load.
>];how[label=<
How it works
Uses Apple WebKit Content Blocker
and the EasyList filter list.
No separate extension to install.
Off by default, so you decide.
Enable: Settings > Browsing > Ad Blocker.
>];limits[label=<
What it doesn’t block
Not every ad is blocked.
Ads served directly by the site
and ads in search results remain.
Firefox new-tab sponsored content
is separate and not affected.
>];privacy[label=<
Works with privacy protections
Complements Enhanced Tracking
Protection, which blocks many trackers
and limits cross-site tracking.
>];choice[label=<
Why it’s optional
Ads help fund the open web.
Desktop/Android keep extension support.
iOS doesn’t support extensions the same way,
so Ad Blocker is built in. You choose.
>];tryit[label=<
Try it
Settings > Browsing > Ad Blocker.
Feedback: Mozilla Connect.
Details: Firefox Support page.
